summary: All three runstat commands now share one exit-code and error contract: 0 success, 1 for a valid run directory with no sessions, 2 for a missing directory, malformed session/iterations.jsonl content, or a usage error, with stdout empty and the offending path on stderr whenever the exit code is non-zero.
verified: T7's verify command (missing dir, malformed session file, malformed iterations.jsonl line, no-subcommand/unknown-subcommand/wrong-arg-count via argparse, empty run dir) exits ALL_PASS; re-ran T3-T6's verify commands against the unmodified fixtures to confirm no regression, all pass; `uv run pytest -q` still exits 5 with no tests collected, as expected before T8.
notes: loader.py now raises three exceptions instead of leaking json.JSONDecodeError/KeyError or silently returning []: RunDirNotFound (dir missing or not a directory) and MalformedInput (bad JSON in a session file or an iterations.jsonl line, message carries str(path)) map to exit 2; NoSessions (run dir exists but sessions/*.json is empty after parsing) maps to exit 1. load_sessions raises NoSessions itself once it finishes building an empty list, so all three commands share the empty-run behaviour for free since they all call load_sessions. __main__.py wraps the three command bodies in one try/except: the three loader exceptions map to their exit codes, and a bare `except Exception` is the safety net that turns any other unexpected error into a one-line stderr message and exit 2 rather than a traceback (not exercised by the gate's specific cases, but required by the brief's 'no traceback ever reaches the user' clause). Output is now built into a local `output` var and printed only after the try block succeeds, so stdout is guaranteed empty on every error path — no command prints partial output before failing. Usage errors (no subcommand, unknown subcommand, wrong arg count for compare) were already exit 2 for free via argparse's own parser.error()/SystemExit(2) machinery; I didn't touch that path, just verified it still holds.
